extension.description: Reviews ctty remote execution (batch exec and bare-host SSH), file transfers (put/get/scp), SFTP/FTP/WebDAV mutations, and local inventory writes (add/edit/move/import), while leaving read-only inspection unmatched.
extension.name: ctty command protection

permissions.description: Identifies `ctty exec`, which runs a remote shell command over SSH on hosts selected by `--tags` and/or `--hosts`. Safe variants: `--list-hosts` and alias `--dry-run` preview the Host set without SSH (upcoming ctty release / `feature/exec-list-hosts` @ 4e91994); `--help`/`-h` likewise clear review.
permissions.label: ctty batch remote execution
safer_guidance: Preview targets with `ctty exec --tags … --list-hosts` (or `--dry-run`) before approving SSH.
Confirm with `ctty search --format json` / `ctty info` when useful.
Keep the host set minimal before approving batch execution.

permissions.description: Identifies `ctty <host> <command…>` / `ctty <host> -- <command…>` remote execution (and similar host-first invocations) that are not a known Cobra subcommand. Known subcommands are cleared via safe variants to avoid false positives on `search`, `info`, `sftp`, etc.
permissions.label: ctty bare-host remote execution
safer_guidance: Prefer `ctty info <host>` then a reviewed one-shot command.
Do not launch interactive `ctty <host>` shells from agents.

permissions.description: Identifies `ctty put`, `ctty get`, and `ctty scp` transfers that read or write remote files via the built-in SFTP client.
permissions.label: ctty remote file transfer
safer_guidance: Confirm host and remote path before transferring.
List with `ctty sftp ls <host> <path> --format json` when only inspection is needed.

permissions.description: Identifies headless FTP mutations and downloads: `ctty ftp get|put|mkdir|rm|rmdir|rename`.
permissions.label: ctty FTP remote mutation/download
safer_guidance: List with `ctty sftp ls <host> <path> --format json` before mutating.

permissions.description: Identifies headless FTP mutations and downloads: `ctty ftp get|put|mkdir|rm|rmdir|rename`.
permissions.label: ctty FTP remote mutation/download
safer_guidance: List with `ctty ftp ls <site> <path> --format json` before mutating.
Prefer SFTP when available; FTP is cleartext.

permissions.description: Identifies headless WebDAV mutations and downloads: `ctty webdav get|put|mkdir|rm|rmdir|rename`.
permissions.label: ctty WebDAV remote mutation/download
safer_guidance: List with `ctty webdav ls <site> <path> --format json` before mutating.

permissions.description: Identifies local inventory / SSH-config mutations: `ctty add`, `ctty edit`, `ctty move`, and `ctty import` (including non-interactive flag forms). `import --dry-run` is a safe variant.
permissions.label: ctty local inventory mutation
safer_guidance: Preview imports with `ctty import <source> --dry-run` before writing.
Prefer reviewing the exact Host block or import source before approving.

rules.description: Identifies `ctty exec` remote SSH. AUTO (safe variants): `--list-hosts`, alias `--dry-run`, and help. Normal exec without those flags stays REVIEW.

safe_variants.title: Exec dry-run alias for list-hosts (no SSH)

safer_alternatives: Confirm hosts with search/info before batch execution.
rules.title: ctty batch remote execution

rules.description: Identifies host-first remote execution and interactive SSH (`ctty <host>`, `ctty <host> <cmd>`, `ctty <host> -- <cmd>`). Safe variants clear every known top-level Cobra subcommand so `search`/`info`/`sftp`/… do not inherit this rule.
safer_alternatives: Use search/info first; avoid interactive bare `ctty <host>` from agents.
rules.title: ctty bare-host remote execution

rules.description: Identifies `ctty put`, `ctty get`, and `ctty scp` (upload and download).
rules.title: ctty remote file transfer

rules.description: Identifies `ctty sftp mkdir|rm|rmdir|rename`. Read-only `sftp ls --format json` is not matched.
safer_alternatives: Inspect with sftp ls --format json before mutating.
rules.title: ctty SFTP remote mutation

rules.description: Identifies headless FTP mutations and downloads: `ctty ftp get|put|mkdir|rm|rmdir|rename`. Read-only list/search/info/ls are not matched.
safer_alternatives: Inspect with ftp ls --format json before mutating.
rules.title: ctty FTP remote mutation/download

rules.description: Identifies headless WebDAV mutations and downloads: `ctty webdav get|put|mkdir|rm|rmdir|rename`. Read-only list/search/info/ls are not matched.
safer_alternatives: Inspect with webdav ls --format json before mutating.
rules.title: ctty WebDAV remote mutation/download

rules.description: Identifies `ctty add|edit|move|import`. `import --dry-run` clears this rule via a safe variant.
safer_alternatives: Use import --dry-run before writing SSH config includes.
rules.title: ctty local inventory mutation

safer_alternatives: Use search/info and … ls --format json for read-only inspection.
Preview imports with --dry-run; confirm hosts before exec/transfers.
